preflight_question: Does an exact current incumbent/control loop already cover the narrow F1 edge: overseas/remote client -> clearly scoped lawful non-specialist China-side physical task -> local execution -> evidence/report?

CLA-LOCAL-TASK-20260923.claim: ChinaLocalAgent explicitly offers clearly scoped local-task execution in China with request review, written quote, local execution, progress checkpoints, photo/video/document evidence and completion reporting for remote teams and other clients.

CLA-HOME-20260923.claim: ChinaLocalAgent explicitly serves overseas clients from one-time/ad-hoc through ongoing local support, takes task/location/deadline/evidence inputs, reviews feasibility, quotes, executes and reports, and lists regional offices in eight major Chinese cities with other locations reviewed case by case.

CBA-ERRAND-20260923.claim: China Biz Agent offers international clients physical-task execution in China including on-site visits, photos/videos, visible-condition checks, pickups/deliveries, simple errands and in-person verification.

CBA-ABOUT-20260923.claim: China Biz Agent states that it operates across mainland China and starts each task from a clear brief describing what must be checked, collected, verified or delivered.

ERRANDS-CHINA-20260923.claim: ErrandsChina directly markets physical-presence errands and operational assistance in China to foreign businesses, overseas Chinese, expats and international individuals, including one-off tasks requiring local presence.

findings: The proposed F1 sequence is already represented nearly field-for-field by an incumbent service: task intake -> scope/feasibility review -> quote -> local execution -> progress/evidence -> completion report.

The incumbent is not limited to specialist factory inspection; its Local Task Execution and Personal Errands boundaries explicitly include low-risk defined tasks, pickup/site confirmation/appointment support and evidence delivery.
A second current provider advertises the same remote international-client to physical-China-task loop with mainland-wide reach, so the evidence is not a single-provider anomaly.

The surviving distinction would have to be a new acquisition, dispatch, trust, settlement or unit-economic advantage; none is evidenced by the broad-reality record. A generic routing layer would therefore duplicate current service control loops rather than expose a proven missing edge.
